remarks: Welcome to 127 Greyrock Place, a luxurious urban retreat in the heart of Stamford. This beautifully updated 1-bedroom, 1-bath residence offers stunning 14th-floor views of Long Island Sound and downtown Stamford. Step inside to discover new luxury vinyl flooring throughout and a modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances, sleek cabinetry, and a breakfast bar that opens to the bright living and dining area. The spacious bedroom features oversized windows that fill the space with natural light and a generous walk-in closet. The bathroom has been completely renovated with high-end finishes, a spa-style shower, and convenient access from both the bedroom and main living area. Additional highlights include central air conditioning and heating for year-round comfort. Located in The Biltmore, one of Stamford's premier full-service condominium buildings, residents enjoy top-tier amenities including a 24-hour concierge, fitness center, resident lounge, shuttle service, laundry facilities, 4th-floor courtyard, and a pet-friendly environment. Garage parking available for $115 per month, per vehicle. Unbeatable location - just steps to Bedford Street's vibrant dining and entertainment scene, and minutes to I-95, Metro-North, and the Merritt Parkway. Experience luxury living and city convenience at its finest at The Biltmore.
